cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put my hand up at lunch like you. My turn for honesty. I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me; now you owe me a risk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was reaching for the salt. I didn't ask you to tell her that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass it along, then. I trusted you to risk something too. What scares you about her?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's equal. Tell her on Sunday; mine had an audience, so yours needs one too.
